thread:
Alex W.: quick sync — we need a minimal, cross-team set of queueing/batching metrics for the console and runtime dashboards. core must-haves: batch size distribution, wait-time percentiles (p50/p95/p99), and a saturation indicator for each dispatcher/batcher. who owns producing these signals?
Priya S.: eng-platform can own the dashboard panels and ingestion pipeline, but runtime needs to emit stable metric names and low-cardinality labels.
Jamie L.: runtime can emit histograms + per-batcher counters. two asks: agreed metric names + sampling rules for high-cardinality models.
Tony R.: infra note — cardinality kills cardinality. please prefer bucketed counts over raw unique keys. recommend these buckets: 1,2,4,8,16,32,64+. also emit total_requests and queued_time_histogram.
Alex W.: good. sketching a proposal: metrics we want from runtime: 
```
redwood.batch.size_bucket{batcher,model_shard,zone}
redwood.batch.size_count{batcher,model_shard,zone}
redwood.batch.wait_ms_histogram{batcher,zone}
redwood.batch.fill_rate{batcher,zone}
redwood.batch.saturation{batcher,zone,level}
```
labels kept small: batcher (name), zone (region), level (low/crit). thoughts?
Priya S.: love explicit names. platform will transform histograms to quantiles for the console. need a p95 latency derived signal name: `redwood.batch.wait_p95` as a derived timeseries for alerts.
Jamie L.: runtime can emit the histogram and a rolling p95 gauge to reduce on-query compute. but we need to agree on reservoir/window length (suggest 1m rolling for p95, 5m for alerts).
Tony R.: +1 on windows. also: add `redwood.batch.backpressure_count` and `redwood.batch.eviction_count` to capture saturation behavior. those are cheap counters.
Alex W.: perfect. on alerting thresholds: platform proposes saturation > 0.7 for 5m and p95 wait > 200ms => P1 page. can we draft a playbook?
Priya S.: I'll own the playbook draft and add panels: 1) batch size distribution heatmap, 2) wait p50/p95/p99 timeline, 3) saturation/buffer usage, 4) slow-path traces link. will iterate in the dashboard repo. @Jamie L. can you post a sample metrics payload? :eyes:
Jamie L.: posting a concise example payload from runtime agent: 
```
{"batcher":"dispatch-a","zone":"us-west-2","size_buckets":{"1":120,"2":400,"4":900,"8":320,"16":40,"32":10,"64+":2},"wait_ms_hist":{"le_10":5000,"le_50":1200,"le_100":300,"le_500":40},"fill_rate":0.78,"saturation":"low","timestamp":1712349999}
```
Priya S.: perfect — that's consumable. platform will convert `size_buckets` to a histogram and create per-model sampling later.
Tony R.: operational note: add a `sample_rate` label for high-model-cardinality teams so we can downsample telemetry before ingest.
Alex W.: next steps: (1) runtime: emit the agreed metric names + rolling p95 gauge — owner Jamie — ETA next Tue, (2) platform: dashboard + playbook draft — owner Priya — ETA Wed, (3) infra: add downsample label support in ingest — owner Tony — ETA Fri. I'll create the tracking ticket and link dashboards when ready. :+1:
infra-bot: created ticket INF-4723 for "queueing/batch metrics onboarding" assigned to Jamie L., Priya S., Tony R.
deploy-bot: staging dashboard updated at https://grafana.redwood/staging/d/queueing-batch/new-panel
Priya S.: thanks everyone. will loop ops and the SRE oncall after playbook draft.
Jamie L.: will post a small PR with the metric emission config and a short test harness.
Alex W.: awesome — closing this quick sync. followups in INF-4723. :rocket:
